scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w cdk-ai-backend && npm run build -w cdk-s3-cloudfront && npm run build -w cdk-serverless-auth && npm run build -w infra && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.deploy:all-dev: npm run build:packages && cd infra && npm run build:layer && cdk deploy InfraStack-dev -c env=dev --outputs-file ../frontend/outputs.json && node generate-env.js && cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd ../infra && cdk deploy InfraStack-dev -c env=dev
scripts.deploy:all-prod: npm run build:packages && cd infra && npm run build:layer && cdk deploy InfraStack-prod -c env=prod --outputs-file ../frontend/outputs.json && node generate-env.js && cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd ../infra && cdk deploy InfraStack-prod -c env=prod
scripts.destroy:dev: cd infra && cdk destroy InfraStack-dev -c env=dev
scripts.destroy:prod: cd infra && cdk destroy InfraStack-prod -c env=prod
